Professional Summary
Early-career Go developer focused on backend services and streaming platforms. Comfortable working in Agile teams to design, implement, and operate microservices with production observability and reliability. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Golang, gRPC, k8s, Docker, Apache Kafka, Prometheus, Agile

Work Experience
Go Developer, Finlytics (Dec 2025 - Present)
- Implemented high-throughput microservices in Golang to process financial event streams, improving end-to-end processing latency by measurable margins while using Apache Kafka for ingestion and delivery.
- Built and maintained gRPC service contracts and client implementations to enable low-latency RPC between services, contributing to stable interservice communication and simplified versioning.
- Containerized services with Docker and deployed to k8s clusters, implementing rolling updates and resource requests/limits to reduce incidents during deploys.
- Instrumented services with Prometheus metrics and alerts and participated in Agile ceremonies to deliver incremental features and respond to production issues.

Education
M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
